sprint.name: Forge Expansion Sprint
sprint.note: A scheduled review is not a guaranteed release. The forge publishes at most one coherent change when it clears the quality and safety gates; otherwise it skips the window.
sprint.secondaryAutomation: A separate GitHub Actions workflow runs Tuesday and Friday at 15:17 UTC. It can only create or improve approved declarative-engine apps and records accepted publishes in this ledger.

method.label: Inspect
method.description: Review the live site, repository, current apps, open feedback, bugs, depth, accessibility, and portfolio gaps.

method.label: Compare
method.description: Consider at least three candidate changes and choose the one that creates the strongest useful depth or breadth.

method.label: Build one
method.description: Create or improve one coherent feature or app, including mobile, keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, teardown, and edge cases.

method.label: Validate
method.description: Run JavaScript syntax checks, feedback-routing tests, registry rules, required-file checks, and safety-boundary validation.

method.label: Publish or skip
method.description: Merge and deploy only after every required check passes. Skip when the candidate is weak, unsafe, duplicative, or incomplete.

qualityGates: One coherent change maximum per review window
No secrets, trackers, accounts, hidden storage, or unreviewed network behavior
No direct execution of user feedback
Mobile, keyboard, touch, focus, and reduced-motion behavior considered
Repository validation must pass before main is published

queue.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.4 budget-aware forecast and six-landscape regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify the forecast never counts unaffordable growth, repairs stressed tiles at zero net replacement cost, accounts for scheduled disturbances, reports species-mix funding risk, restores exactly through undo, recalculates after adaptation, and preserves six-landscape winnability, keyboard grid navigation, touch, reduced motion, and teardown.

queue.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.4 recovery, history, progression, input, and audio regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify failed submissions and studio reset clear pre-failure undo history, the 250-point penalty and streak loss cannot be reversed, unused moves remain bounded, all six commissions remain winnable, and spatial keyboard input, native activation, audio, touch, reduced-motion, silent fallback, and teardown remain correct.

queue.title: Panelcraft 1.0.2 action-limit regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify placement stops at zero design actions, undo restores exactly one action and budget state, recovery grants two emergency actions, all incidents remain winnable, and keyboard, mobile, reduced-motion, and teardown behavior remain intact.

queue.title: Folding Frontier 1.1.1 keyboard regression playtest
queue.reason: Verify focused controls activate only themselves; global shortcuts still work from non-interactive regions; repeated close and reopen cycles remove old listeners.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.4
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced the action-only capacity estimate with a budget-aware planner that models affordable growth, free stressed-tile repairs, scheduled shocks, and species-mix funding risk.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Rebalanced the final three landscapes against disturbance-reduced healthy capacity and added a live capacity forecast so all six progression gates are strategically legible and attainable.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Made stressed habitat consistently inactive across species counts, connectivity, links, diversity, quality, gates, survey language, and accessible cell labels until repaired or cleared by emergency adaptation.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced remaining-action shock timing with a per-landscape successful-placement counter so disturbances occur after placements 3, 6, 9, and 12, with exact undo and recovery continuity.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Selected and published a spatial ecology restoration game because terrain adjacency, migration corridors, seasonal shocks, species goals, and recovery add a distinct strategic system to the collection.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.4
recentDecisions.summary: Made rejection and studio recovery firm undo-history boundaries so the score penalty and lost streak cannot be restored from a pre-failure snapshot.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Prevented rejected commissions from multiplying unused studio moves: recovery now preserves any remaining moves and only raises exhausted takes to a three-move minimum.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Made arrow navigation follow the visible four-track sequencer: horizontal movement wraps within a track and vertical movement preserves the beat column across tracks while retaining native activation and global-shortcut boundaries.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Restored native Space and Enter activation for focused sequencer steps, limited arrow handling to roving grid focus, and restricted global play, undo, and submit shortcuts to non-interactive regions.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Added a six-commission local Web Audio composition game with a four-track sequencer, constrained studio moves, visible mix gates, progression, exact undo, failure, recovery, touch, keyboard, silent fallback, and teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Panelcraft 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Changed control relocation to charge only the destination-versus-origin zone cost difference, returning budget on cheaper moves while preserving one-action moves and exact undo.

recentDecisions.title: Crisis Channel 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Restricted the one-use mediator to failed talks or an exhausted final round, closing a free early-session trust, pressure, and capital exploit while preserving recovery and teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Crisis Channel 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Made the one-use mediator available after a failed settlement or channel collapse, blocked other actions until recovery or restart, and prevented rejected settlements from awarding score.

recentDecisions.title: Crisis Channel 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced redraw-time action listener accumulation with one delegated click handler so each negotiation action executes exactly once, with explicit click and keyboard teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Crisis Channel 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Added a six-case branching negotiation simulator with trust, pressure, intelligence, capital, visible agreement gates, progression, failure, exact undo, recovery, keyboard and touch controls, reduced motion, and teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Gallery Gambit 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Closed the conservation-economy exploit by limiting protection to fragile galleries and charging one planning action for protection or reopening while preserving exact undo, mobile controls, and teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Gallery Gambit 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Rebalanced route planning around staggered visitor groups, attainable day gates, explicit planning actions, and nonnegative budget guards while preserving accessibility, conservation, recovery, mobile controls, and teardown.

recentDecisions.title: Gallery Gambit 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Added route planning across visitor preferences, accessibility, room capacity, conservation, budget, and timed progression.

recentDecisions.title: Outbreak Atlas 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Expired tested and traced observations when the day advances while preserving deterministic undo and current-day risk highlighting.

recentDecisions.title: Panelcraft 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Enforced the eight-action incident limit and restored actions through undo and recovery.
